content.title: About
content.content: This cookie combines dark chocolate, rolled oats and shredded coconut, requires no baking and is ready in minutes. The texture is soft with a slight crunch, and the flavor is rich chocolate with hints of coconut and oat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Oats give the cookie extra fiber and help it hold together without baking.
Coconut adds a fragrant tropical note and healthy fats.
The chocolate can be dark or milk, depending on preference.
The cookie sets in the refrigerator, making it an ideal summer treat.
No‑bake preparation preserves more nutrients, especially from the oats.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Oats contain soluble fiber that supports digestion and helps maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Coconut provides medium‑chain triglycerides that are quickly metabolized for energy.

items.title: Antioxidants from chocolate
items.content: Dark chocolate is high in flavonoids, which protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Heart‑friendly
items.content: The mix of monounsaturated fats from coconut and fiber from oats can support healthy cholesterol levels.

items.title: Mood boost
items.content: Chocolate stimulates serotonin production, which can improve mood and increase energy.

items.title: Nut and coconut allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to coconut or ingredients in the chocolate.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The cookie is calorie‑dense due to fats and sugar, so portion control is recommended.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: If sweetened chocolate is used, the sugar level can be high, which may be unsuitable for diabetics.

items.title: Gluten presence
items.content: Rolled oats may contain trace gluten unless certified gluten‑free.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The cookie is convenient as a standalone snack, added to yogurt, ice cream, or used as a base for dessert plates. Keep it chilled to maintain its firmness.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cookies in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze in a zip‑lock bag and thaw at room temperature before serving.
